evals.prompt: UV a 2m modular wall set on a 2048 atlas at 512px/m with 8px candidate padding and a separate requested lightmap channel.
evals.expected_output: Revision-scoped work or read-only findings with concrete technical and visual acceptance evidence; missing execution is identified.
assertions: Avoids rescaling away absolute density and checks padding.
Keeps channel semantics and current checker evidence.

evals.prompt: Repair a UV report claiming perfect efficiency: islands overlap, a closed cylinder unwrap collapsed and packing rescaled the requested density.
evals.expected_output: Revision-scoped work or read-only findings with concrete technical and visual acceptance evidence; missing execution is identified.
assertions: Adds meaningful cylinder seams and measures post-pack density.
Does not treat occupancy or UV-layer existence as visual proof.
